task_name: Define shared data-intelligence schema and API contracts

concerns_addressed: Critical INSERT immutability: BEFORE INSERT triggers added for both SQLite and PostgreSQL; regression test confirms insert into published snapshot is rejected.
Important DELETE trigger fix: PostgreSQL DELETE now uses dedicated delete_guard returning OLD; unpublished value delete succeeds while published value delete is rejected.
Important nullable dimension_key duplicates: partial unique index on (snapshot_id,section) WHERE dimension_key IS NULL enforced; duplicate scalar row rejected.
Important non-UUID fixtures: all fixtures now use valid UUID strings matching uuid column types.
Important RefreshDatabase transaction abort: assertDatabaseRejects wraps each operation in DB::transaction to isolate constraint failures.

strengths: Correct separation of PostgreSQL trigger functions for INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE each with correct return value.
assertDatabaseRejects helper DRYs eight constraint-rejection assertions.
SQLite and PostgreSQL paths are structurally parallel and driver-gated.
Down migration drops all triggers/functions in reverse dependency order.
